changelog:
Initial release of aws-agent-orchestrator-free: a free agent orchestration helper based on AWS Bedrock AgentCore and LangGraph, targeting individual developers with rapid single-agent deployment and core orchestration features.

- Supports quick deployment (under 5 min) of single-agent HTTP services using Bedrock AgentCore and LangGraph
- Includes full CLI command support for local development, hot reload, and container launch
- Covers essential capabilities: state graph orchestration, short-term memory, local tool integration
- Premium (pro) features like multi-agent orchestration, Gateway toolchain, and long-term memory are locked
- Clear documentation, setup instructions, code templates, and troubleshooting FAQ included
- No API key required for core functions; compatible across Windows/macOS/Linux environments
summary: 基于AWS Bedrock AgentCore与LangGraph的多智能体编排部署助手，免费体验核心编排能力，适合个人开发者快速上手。
